name: infinite elements
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用于描述无界域或远场边界行为的数值离散单元。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道—土体等相互作用模型中，与土体有限元配合处理远场，使有限计算区域能够表示向无穷远延伸的介质；部分模型通过位移衰减和坐标映射描述远域行为。

complete_examples.text: The soil around the tunnel is regarded as an elastic half-space, and mapping infinite elements are introduced to model the external boundary of tunnels and the far field vibration of the soil space.
By applying the infinite elements and the cyclic calculation method, the radiation condition of the soil is satisfied, and the high DOFs of track-tunnel finite element systems have been reduced.
The soil is defined as an infinite region, where the half-space is classified into near-field finite ele ments and far-field infinite elements.

By using the infinite elements and finite elements for soil simulation, the boundary condition that the far-field displacement of the soil is zero can be strictly met even if the computational range is limited.
